en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a large, neoclassical-style building with ornate windows and decorative cornices. The building is surrounded by a low stone wall and some trees. The caption along the bottom is in three languages: Bulgarian (Cyrillic), English, and French, identifying the location and the building as a boys' gymnasium (school) in Stara Zagora.
